item.title: Spotting the Unseen: How Netflix’s Pixel‑Error AI Revolutionizes Video QC
item.description: Discover how Netflix engineers built a real‑time neural network that detects hot and dead pixels at full resolution, slashing manual review from hours to minutes and letting creators focus on storytelling.

item.title: The Third Era ofAI Coding: Autonomous Agents Building Software Factories
item.description: Michael Truell explains how AI-assisted coding evolved from tab autocomplete to synchronous agents and now to autonomous cloud agents that handle large tasks independently, reshaping developer roles and Cursor's workflow.

item.title: Beyond the P‑Value:How Netflix Builds Confidence in A/B Test Decisions
item.description: In this episode, Netflix engineers reveal the holistic framework they use to turn statistical results into confident product decisions—examining hypothesis alignment, metric storytelling, variant consistency, and the limits of p‑values.
